q1.sampleAnswer: She usually saves it to buy presents for her family and CDs for herself.

examples: saves it to buy presents for her family

q1.rubricZh: 要点：存钱给家人买礼物；也给自己买 CD。
q1.explanationZh: Maya 说她努力存钱给家人买礼物，也经常把零花钱花在 CD 上。

evidence.quote: I try to save and buy presents for my family.
I also often spend my pocket money on CDs.

q2.sampleAnswer: He would do some housework to earn the extra money.

examples: do some housework to earn the extra money

q2.rubricZh: 要点：做家务挣额外的钱。
q2.explanationZh: Jimmy 说如果东西贵、钱不够，妈妈可能补给他一点，有时他还得做家务来挣钱。

evidence.quote: Sometimes I have to do housework to earn extra money.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because he knows some parents can’t afford to give their kids much pocket money.

keyPoints.descZh: 知道有些父母给不起很多零花钱
examples: some parents can’t afford to give their kids much pocket money

q3.rubricZh: 要点：他知道有些父母负担不起给孩子很多零花钱。
q3.explanationZh: 他知道有些家长给不起太多零花钱，所以不在学校谈这件事，免得让别的同学难受。

evidence.quote: I know some parents can’t afford to give their kids much pocket money.

q4.sampleAnswer: Parents should give their kids pocket money for three reasons. First of all, kids may need money to buy things when they go out with their friends. Secondly, it's a good way to teach kids the value of money. Last but not least, after receiving pocket money, kids can learn about money management.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 理由一：孩子和朋友出去时可能需要钱
examples: kids may need money to buy things when they go out with their friends

keyPoints.descZh: 理由二：能让孩子懂得钱的价值
examples: it's a good way to teach kids the value of money

keyPoints.descZh: 理由三：能学会管理金钱
examples: kids can learn about money management

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：至少写出三条合理的理由，言之有理即可。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。可以从出去玩要用钱、让孩子懂钱的价值、学会理财等方面写至少三点。

q5.explanationZh: need to ___ more time together 表示“花（时间）”，spend time together 是“共度时光”。

q6.explanationZh: can afford 表示“买得起”，没有多少人买得起那样的房子。

q7.explanationZh: save the planet 是“拯救地球”，每个人都要尽一份力。

q8.explanationZh: the same ... as 是“和……一样的”，她穿的裙子和我的一样。

q9.explanationZh: cost 作动词是“花费”，主语 it 是单数，所以用 costs。

q10.explanationZh: extra warmth 是“额外的温暖”，意思是再多穿一件保暖。

accept: spends his pocket money on (buying) books
spends his pocket money on buying books
spends his pocket money on books

q11.explanationZh: “把钱花在……上”是 spend money on，后面接名词或 doing，主语 he 是单数，所以用 spends。

accept: showing off what I have got

q12.explanationZh: like the idea of 后面接 doing，“炫耀”是 show off，what I’ve got 是“我所拥有的东西”。

accept: the same pair of trainers as his friend
the same pair of trainers as his friends
the same trainers as his friend
the same trainers as his friends

q13.explanationZh: “和……一样的”用 the same ... as，鞋是一双，所以用 the same pair of trainers。

accept: talk about her pocket money with her friends
talk about her pocket money with her friend

q14.explanationZh: “谈论”是 talk about，主语是 she，前面有 doesn’t，所以动词用原形 talk。

accept: won’t be able to afford the present for her mother
will not be able to afford the present for her mother
won’t be able to afford a present for her mother
won’t be able to afford the present for her mum
won’t be able to afford a present for her mum

q15.explanationZh: “没钱买得起”用 afford，前面是 she，if 句用一般现在时，主句用 won’t be able to afford。

accept: spend my pocket money on toys or I can save it
spend my pocket money on toys or save it

q16.explanationZh: can either 后面接动词原形：spend ... on toys，再用 or 连接“也可以存起来”。
